_comment: SAMPLE / SCHEMA for build/build.sh output (build-manifest.json). This template ships status=UNBUILT on purpose: publish-to-r2.sh MUST refuse to upload it. A real manifest is produced only by build.sh after pmbootstrap emits a .img on a Linux aarch64/cross host, which flips status to BUILT and fills in the real sha256/pins. The Postern packages are INSTALLED from the live signed R2 repo (../PUBLISHED.md), not rebuilt. Never hand-edit status to BUILT.
install_source: published apk repo — packages installed, NOT rebuilt
attestation: none — signed & publisher-authenticated only; NOT reproducible, NOT attested

published_repo.key_note: alpha BUILD key, not a stable release key (../PUBLISHED.md)
